text: "Someone else's computer" undersells what actually changed. Cloud computing is renting compute, storage, and networking from a provider — available in minutes, billed by actual usage.

Capital expenditure is a large upfront purchase that depreciates over years. Operating expenditure scales with actual use, like a utility bill. Cloud computing turns most infrastructure spending from CapEx into OpEx.
On-demand self-service, broad network access, resource pooling, rapid elasticity, measured service — five real, specific traits, not vague marketing language.
Azure is one of the three major public clouds, and this course is a focused primer that sits before any Azure-flavored course in this catalog. Next up: IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.
